run_dfs_graph: run depth-first search on a graph adjacency matrix and return the parent array
run_bfs_graph: run breadth-first search from a source node on a graph adjacency matrix
run_topological_sort: run topological sort on a directed acyclic graph adjacency matrix
run_dijkstra_shortest_path: run Dijkstra's single-source shortest path algorithm on a weighted graph adjacency matrix
run_floyd_warshall: run Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest paths algorithm on a weighted graph adjacency matrix
